name: codex-auto-resume
description: Resume the exact Codex task that a usage limit interrupted, once the limit resets. Local-only, read-only against Codex state, and conservative by design.

interface.shortDescription: Resume a usage-limited task after the reset
interface.longDescription: When a Codex task stops because you ran out of usage, this remembers the exact conversation and resumes it after the limit resets. A small local watcher does the waiting, so it keeps working after you close the app. It only acts on usage-limit interruptions, only on the exact interrupted conversation, and does nothing when the state is uncertain.
